name: omnilab/openaq
description: Omnilab OpenAQ: air quality measurements of the OpenAQ platform (API v3) - the hourly or daily averages of a pollutant (PM2.5, PM10, NO2, O3, SO2, CO, black carbon... by OpenAQ's parameter names) at the nearest location of a point measuring it, in the sensor's unit. An OpenAQ API key is required (the user's own, sent as X-API-Key); not tested live.
